latest_scientific_finding.summary: For 500 matched synthetic race identities, W0-W4 had exactly identical PRE hashes and empirical I(PRE;world) was numerically zero, while hidden oracle distributions differed materially (mean pairwise TV 0.1391; minimum pair mean 0.0516). Current W0-W4 therefore tests universal robustness but cannot fairly test a learned PRE-only regime selector.

current_research_objective: Preserve current W0-W4 as immutable universal robustness stress lanes. Build a separately versioned learnable-regime synthetic twin where hidden mechanism intensity is a deterministic function of PRE-observable variables without exposing a direct regime label or any outcome. Then preregister a disjoint-seed comparison of universal versus PRE-adaptive probability objects. This remains synthetic engineering falsification only.
exact_next_executable_actions: Create Digital Twin v2 without modifying v1: a learnable synthetic mechanism whose intensity is a preregistered deterministic function of PRE-observable wind/line/score-uncertainty features.
Do not expose the hidden mechanism intensity or direct regime label to prediction interfaces; predictors may use only ordinary PRE fields.
Preregister candidate adaptive mapping family, design seed, evaluation seed, and gates before synthetic scoring.
Use disjoint synthetic design/evaluation seeds; freeze one adaptive candidate before evaluation or stop if no candidate qualifies.
Compare against fixed universal C0/N1/global-mixture baselines and record failures without rescue tuning.
Make no real-keirin calibration, economics, ROI, profitability, or model-promotion claim.
